met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Gangetic West Bengal & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
A trough runs from North Interior Karnataka to south Gujarat across Madhya Maharashtra and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Madhya Maharashtra and neighbourhood has merged with the above mentioned trough from North Interior Karnataka to south Gujarat.
An upper air cyclonic circulation is likely to emerge over South Andaman Sea around 29th November 2026.
A fresh Western Disturbance likely to affect western Himalaya region from night of 2nd December.
The trough in easterlies from southern parts of Lakshadweep to Coastal Karnataka across Eastcentral Arabian Sea extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
